mapper.sql: id, post_id, adopter_id, message, status, reject_reason, version, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adoption_applications (post_id, adopter_id, message, status) VALUES (#{postId}, #{adopterId}, #{message}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE adoption_applications SET status = 'WITHDRAWN', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND adopter_id = #{adopterId} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE adoption_applications SET status = 'REJECTED', reject_reason = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
UPDATE adoption_applications SET status = 'APPROVED', version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING'
